name: modern-action-malformed-ref
description: A modern tools/call for an action tool (click) whose snapshot_ref is not a well-formed handle is rejected before any side effect. The result is a decorated modern isError tool result whose structuredContent.error reports snapshot_ref_malformed with retry new_state. The malformed check precedes all platform code, so the bytes are identical on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

content.text: Malformed snapshot_ref. Call get_app_state and pass the returned snapshot_ref.

error.message: Malformed snapshot_ref. Call get_app_state and pass the returned snapshot_ref.
